cells.tense: You are here at the finished thing, with thought moving fast and clean through it.
cells.act: start something for the spark of starting
cells.ask: Begin something small in the next few days with nothing planned past the first hour, and keep it shapeless while you work. The starting itself is the whole errand.
cells.core:
You're at the end of something you built, and thought moves fast through it now. You can look at a messy pile of details and come out the other side holding the line that matters. Better still, the pull that got you here is still pointing outward — you can see what you want next, and there's no rule against wanting it.

The next thing doesn't need a strategy. Begin something small with no plan past the first hour, and keep it shapeless while you work. You'll want to name the goal and map the route; the pull is the part you'd lose that way. Do it for the starting itself — the spark when a thing begins — and keep whatever it becomes open a while longer.
cells.sheetLine: You can see what you want next, and you're allowed to want it.
cells.verb: cutting through to what is actually true, at speed
cells.place: in the pull toward the light you would steer by

cells.tense: You are bracing for a future you cannot yet write into being.
cells.act: cut through the inertia with one decisive act
cells.ask: Today, make the actual next move on what you keep planning toward — the real one, not another pass. One move, one day.
cells.core:
You're operating at full speed, cutting through everything in your path, and the future is where the pressure sits. Every plan gets built tighter before it's tested. You've been sharpening the route so long that the trip keeps not starting, and the pull toward what you want has turned into a schedule for wanting it.

That speed is worth something. Make the actual next move today on what you keep refining — the real one, not another pass. The decision already exists; you made some version of it a while back. Let the week catch up to the decision instead of you catching up to the plan, and watch how much clearer the way looks once something has actually moved.

cells.verb: cutting through to what is actually true, at speed

cells.tense: You are still standing at a door that is already behind you.
cells.act: pursue the emotional truth with someone
cells.ask: Sit with someone and follow what they actually feel about something, past the tidy version they first offer. Stay in it as long as it runs.
cells.core:
You can think your way through nearly anything, and lately it hasn't been getting you back to the light. The pull toward what you want is still there but you've stopped letting it point at anything; you look for reasons instead of direction, and reasons are quieter. The reasoning runs, but the night sky has gone vague.

One honest exchange is what charges this back. Sit with someone and follow what they actually feel about something, past the tidy version they first offer. You don't have to solve it or comment on it. The pull gets its current back from contact, not from thought about contact, and the contact has to be real enough to feel.
cells.sheetLine: The reasons keep running, but the night sky has gone vague.
cells.verb: cutting through to what is actually true, at speed
cells.place: in the pull toward the light you would steer by

cells.tense: You are writing already in a place you don't think you're holding the pen in.
cells.act: hold space for what someone feels without fixing it
cells.ask: When someone brings you something hard, take all of it in and give no answer until they've finished, however long that runs. That's the whole thing.
cells.core:
The line that gets you toward what you want is being drawn by your hand, and you'd tell anyone it drew itself. You say the fast, true thing while the talking is still going, the way sharpens, and you file it under the situation being that way. The sharpness belongs to you. You don't claim it, so it doesn't count as anything to anyone, including yourself.

There's a simpler form of the same gift, and it runs through feeling rather than analysis. When someone brings you something hard, take all of it in and give no answer until they've finished, however long that runs. The recognition you hand them is the kind you're already handing the whole conversation. Watch your own hand in it, just this time.
cells.sheetLine: The sharpness is yours. You file it under the situation.
cells.verb: cutting through to what is actually true, at speed
cells.place: in the pull toward the light you would steer by
